claims.text: HSV or VZV ALF: acyclovir 5-10 mg/kg IV Q8h.
claims.quote: Patients with herpes hepatitis or varicella zoster-related ALF should receive acyclovir 5 to 10 mg/kg IV every 8 hours.
Antiviral therapy is recommended for patients with liver failure due to reactivation of hepatitis B

claims.text: Sus AIH: IV methylprednisolone 60 mg/day may help.
claims.quote: Patients with suspected autoimmune hepatitis may benefit from intravenous methylprednisolone at a dose of 60 mg/day.
